From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>

Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Sarah / David,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — really appreciate you walking me through the priority workflows. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can move to a kickoff once you confirm success criteria: 

What we demoed
- Redwood hosted inference: low-latency chat and batch embeddings for customer support routing
- Routing policies: model fallbacks and cost-aware routing for non-sensitive queries
- Console: token-level cost breakdown and evaluation hooks

Proposed 3-week POC (high level)
1) Week 0 — Prep (this week)
   - Agree success criteria and test data slices (see success criteria below)
   - Provide sample dataset (anonymized) or grant S3 access for us to load
2) Week 1 — Integration + model selection
   - SE (Alex) helps with environment allowlist and test infra
   - Baseline runs with open models + recommendations
3) Week 2 — Evaluation + tuning
   - Run evaluation harness, measure latency/cost, quality on test prompts
   - Apply quantization/batching suggestions if needed
4) Week 3 — Handover + expansion plan
   - Final report, recommended prod config, next steps for Dedicated or Private

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 512-token responses on our specified test set
- Cost: per-response cost < $0.02 for the evaluated traffic profile
- Quality: > 85% on the rubric (intent classification + answer accuracy)
- Reliability: sustained throughput of 20 qps during 5m bursts

Owners
- FinServCorp: Sarah Lim (product lead) — approve success criteria & provide data; David Owens (CTO) — procurement/infra approval
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE) — program lead; Alex Martinez (SE) — technical lead

Attachments
- 20270809-finserv-poc-plan-v1.pdf (POC outline + timeline)
- redwood-soc2-attestation.pdf (SOC2 summary; full report available on request)

Next steps
1) Please confirm or edit the success criteria above by EOD tomorrow.
2) If acceptable, confirm availability for a technical kickoff — suggested times: Wed 11 Aug 10:00am PT or Thu 12 Aug 9:00am PT.
3) Alex will follow up with a pre-kickoff checklist once times are confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you up and running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0168

Thanks all — confirmed kickoff Wed 11 Aug 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Quick pre-kickoff checklist for FinServCorp engineering (please send answers/replies before the call):

1) Sample dataset
   - Provide an anonymized sample of ~500–1,000 records representative of the helpdesk interactions (CSV or JSONL). If easier, provide S3 read-only path and IAM role.
2) Network allowlist
   - IP ranges to allow for our hosted test endpoints (we'll send a short allowlist).
3) Access & auth
   - If testing with private datasets, confirm whether you prefer temporary S3 access or secure upload via our console.
4) Success criteria confirmation
   - Confirm the finalized latency (95th / 99th), cost target, and the rubric for quality scoring.
5) Contact for engineering questions
   - Name, email, Slack handle for the engineer who will join the kickoff.

We will bring: evaluation harness, baseline model runs, simple dashboard with P95/P99 latency and cost for the first 48 hours.

Looking forward to the kickoff.
